findings.title: 42 Published HTML Pages Missing from XML Sitemap
findings.evidence: sitemap.xml lists 55 HTML pages out of 97 total HTML pages on disk (42 unlisted, including medical/dental/belrose/, bexley/, bondi/, blackalls-park/, and medical/endocrinology/)
findings.description: 42 production HTML pages are absent from sitemap.xml. While internal linking aids discovery, search engines rely heavily on sitemaps for crawl scheduling and canonical index prioritization of programmatic directory pages.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate sitemap.xml to include all 97 HTML routes with accurate lastmod timestamps (YYYY-MM-DD) and tiered priorities (1.0 home, 0.8 categories, 0.6 suburbs).

findings.title: Raw Markdown (.md) URLs Declared in Standard XML Sitemap
findings.evidence: sitemap.xml contains 56 .md URLs (e.g., https://australia.md/docs/culture.md) served with content-type: text/markdown
findings.description: Standard web search engines (Google, Bing) expect sitemap URLs to serve indexable HTML documents. Mixing raw markdown documents into the primary sitemap dilutes crawl budget and generates non-canonical index warnings in Google Search Console.
findings.recommendation: Separate web sitemaps from AI manifests. Exclude raw .md files from sitemap.xml and serve them via llms.txt or a secondary ai-sitemap.xml.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options)
findings.evidence: Live HTTP response headers lack Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, and X-Frame-Options
findings.description: Direct hosting on GitHub Pages without a reverse proxy or Cloudflare CDN layer prevents injecting custom security headers, precluding HSTS domain preload eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Route DNS through Cloudflare (or a Cloudflare Worker / edge reverse proxy) to inject HSTS (max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload), CSP, and nosniff headers.

findings.title: Top-Level Category Hub Pages Contain Thin Content (<250 words)
findings.evidence: 8 hub pages have low word counts: submit (102w), education (198w), tourism (200w), government (205w), environment (223w), economy (232w), technology (232w), history (240w)
findings.description: Category hubs currently act predominantly as link matrices to documentation files without providing standalone topical depth. Google core updates favor hub pages with comprehensive contextual overviews.
findings.recommendation: Expand each hub page with 150-250 words of verified executive summaries, core national statistics (ABS/statutory data), and key domain FAQs.

findings.title: Sub-optimal Title Tag Length on Top-Level Category Hubs
findings.evidence: culture/index.html title is 'Culture & Arts | Australia.md' (29 chars); flora-fauna/index.html title is 'Flora & Fauna | Australia.md' (28 chars)
findings.description: Titles under 30 characters underutilize Google SERP real estate and miss opportunities for secondary topical keywords.
findings.recommendation: Expand titles to 50-60 characters (e.g., 'Culture & Arts in Australia: Sovereign National Archive' and 'Flora & Fauna of Australia: Biodiversity & Species Records').

findings.title: Dentist Schema Missing GeoCoordinates, Opening Hours, and PriceRange
findings.evidence: All 40+ dental clinic directory pages declare Dentist schema with PostalAddress and telephone, but omit 'geo' (latitude/longitude), 'openingHoursSpecification', and 'priceRange'
findings.description: Rich local business snippets and Google Maps integration require or strongly recommend geographical coordinates and operating hours for local pack eligibility.
findings.recommendation: Enrich the clinic schema generation pipeline to include geo coordinates (suburb centroid or clinic geocode), priceRange ('$$'), and openingHours.

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList Schema on Sub-Category and Directory Pages
findings.evidence: Pages below the root (e.g., medical/dental/chatswood/) feature visual navigation breadcrumbs but omit BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema
findings.description: Without BreadcrumbList schema, search engines may display raw URL paths instead of formatted hierarchical breadcrumbs in search results.
findings.recommendation: Add JSON-LD BreadcrumbList schema to all sub-pages representing the visual trail (e.g., Home > Medical > Dental > Chatswood).

findings.title: Missing Explicit Width and Height Attributes on Homepage PNG Assets
findings.evidence: index.html image elements for flag-australia.png, commonwealth-star.png, golden-wattle.png, and coat-of-arms.png lack HTML width and height attributes
